name: 타무라 텍스처 특징
description: 추출합니다 perceptual texture 특징 (coarseness, 대비, directionality) 식별하기 위해 unnatural texture characteristics typical of AI 생성 images.
mechanism: Computes Tamura coarseness 분석하여 local average differences at multiple scales, and directionality by computing 기울기 orientation 히스토그램s. AI images tend to have lower coarseness and more isotropic 기울기 분포s.
parameters: Scales: 5 levels (2^1 to 2^5), Gradient: Sobel operator, Orientation bins: 16
accuracy: 중간 — 65-78%, 보완적 텍스처 신호로 가장 적합
source: Tamura, H. et al. (1978) — Textural Features Corresponding to Visual Perception, IEEE SMC
useCase: Detecting unnatural texture properties in AI 생성 surfaces and materials

references.title: Tamura, H. et al. (1978). Textural Features Corresponding to Visual Perception. IEEE SMC.

strengths:
• Perceptually meaningful 특징
• Captures texture at multiple scales
• Independent of image content
• Fast computation
limitations:
• Lower standalone 정확도
• Sensitive to image 해상도
• May overlap with other texture methods
• AI improving at texture generation
